xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfBoardC: During 2025-26, Board composition of the Company was not in compliance of the provisions of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. As on 31st March, 2026, the Company has vacancy of Five (5) Independent Directors [including one (1) Women Independent Director]. Since the appointment of Independent Directors in the case of all the Government Companies is being made by the Government, multiple requests were made for filling the vacant posts of Independent Directors, however, they are yet to be appointed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfQuorum: Since the Company did not have any independent director from 28.04.2025 to 14.05.2025, one meeting of the Board was conducted on 13.05.2026 for considering business of urgent nature, without presence of an independent director. However, since the matter was beyond the control of the Company, waiver under Regulation 17(2A) was granted to the Company upon appointment of two Independent Directors by the Government on 15.05.2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfCompos: Due to non availability of minimum two independent directors in the Company, the Committee was not in valid constitution till 01.06.2025. On appointment of two independent directors in the Company by the Govt, the constitution of the Committee was regularised w.e.f. 02.06.2025. Since the matter was beyond the control of the Company, waiver under the said Regulation was granted to the Company.
